items.title: Trump endorses embattled Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu for reelection
items.summary: Trump said in a post on social media that Netanyahu "has been a Great Warrior Prime Minister, and an even greater Partner for Peace in combatting the Islamic Republic of Iran."

items.title: Pope Leo says he will gradually resume duties after cancer surgery
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV thanked thousands of faithful in St. Peter's Square on Sunday for their prayers while he was hospitalized, and said he plans to gradually return to his usual duties.

items.title: Carney says 4 service members killed and dozens injured in fire at Alberta military base
